source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Combat Patrol is the fastest way into 40K for new and experienced players: compact armies, games of up to an hour.

- Each player [picks a patrol](vsdata:core-rule/combat-patrol.select-combat-patrols), usually what one Combat Patrol box contains; no army list or points totals are needed.
- Each patrol has its own mission that earns VP; the player with the most VP at the end wins.
- Trying other factions teaches their tactics, strengths and weaknesses before larger battles.
